Home / Learn / Maths Path / Class 3

Maths Path · Ages 7 to 8

Class 3 maths

Thousands, multiplying, fractions and timetables. Go in order. Pass each check to open the next chapter.

0 of 10 passed

Class 3 chapters in order

  1. 1

    Thousands and number names

    Read and say four-digit numbers like 4265, compare them and round them.

    • I can build and name a four-digit number.
    • I can order and round numbers.
    • I can solve a number clue.
    Not started
  2. 2

    Multiply, divide and solve stories

    Multiply with arrays, share equally, use written methods and solve two-step stories.

    • I can multiply and share equally.
    • I can find a missing digit.
    • I can choose operations for a story.
    Not started
  3. 3

    Equal parts and fractions

    Read shaded fractions, find equal fractions and take a fraction of a group.

    • I can read a shaded fraction.
    • I can compare equal fractions.
    • I can find a fraction of a group.
    Not started
  4. 4

    Shapes, reflections and boundaries

    Describe flat and solid shapes, find symmetry and measure the boundary.

    • I can describe flat and solid shapes.
    • I can find symmetry and mirror images.
    • I can find a shape's boundary length.
    Not started
  5. 5

    Read scales and change units

    Read scales on rulers and thermometers, compare mass and capacity, and change units.

    • I can read a ruler or thermometer.
    • I can compare mass and capacity.
    • I can combine mixed units.
    Not started
  6. 6

    Time, timetables and dates

    Read clocks to five minutes, work out time that crosses the hour and use dates.

    • I can read and choose clocks.
    • I can work out elapsed time.
    • I can use dates and timetables.
    Not started
  7. 7

    Shopping totals and better buys

    Add prices, find change, compare pack prices and choose within a budget.

    • I can total prices and find change.
    • I can compare pack prices.
    • I can choose within a budget.
    Not started
  8. 8

    Picture charts, bars and tables

    Read picture charts and bar charts, compare results and update a table.

    • I can use a picture-chart key.
    • I can compare values on a bar chart.
    • I can update a table or chart.
    Not started
  9. 9

    Number, letter and picture patterns

    Complete number series, letter patterns and picture rules.

    • I can complete a number series.
    • I can complete a letter pattern.
    • I can copy a picture rule.
    Not started
  10. 10

    Codes, positions and picture puzzles

    Use codes and clues, find ranks and ways to choose, and follow directions.

    • I can use a code or word clue.
    • I can find ranks and allowed combinations.
    • I can find a hidden letter and follow directions.
    Not started

Olympiad-style paper

When the chapters feel easy, try a mixed paper written in the style of Olympiad papers. The questions are original to Otterly, and this is not an official exam.
